metadata.summary: Scoped assurance incident queries and attributable acknowledgement; no remediation authority.

semantics.description: get/list/acknowledge only same-scope incidents under Host grants plus independently mapped local identity. Explicit acknowledge requestId retries are durable actor+scope bound; collisions conflict. Evidence-backed resolution only; no manual resolve or annotations. Signals are best-effort public typed events, broker provenance plus local target authorization required. Historical provenance confers no current authority. See ../DESIGN.md. Draft metadata is not review approval.

evidence.conformance: conformance.json; docs/phase5.2/evidence/d13-native.log actual23/23 native public Host/SDK and domain tests. No-container, no daemon or provider; local native operator trust, trustVerified=false.

proposal.abstraction: One minimal provider-neutral incident get/list/acknowledge capability with one typed signal event. No control, generic health transport, probes, import/export or administrative mutations.
proposal.alternatives: No broad doghouse family, no arbitrary HTTP probe and no private Kernel shortcut. Canonical exchange is restricted operator workflow, not this capability.
proposal.compatibility: Additive proposal only; original Catalog and Foundation unchanged. Distinct real review before PROPOSED, actual conformance before EXPERIMENTAL admission. Development fixture experimental metadata is not admission.
consumers: Public SDK isolated incident reader/acknowledger, no Doghouse or store imports
proposal.existingInsufficient: Echo, neutral records, decision and memory-candidates do not express assurance lifecycle or provenance; frozen contracts cannot be silently repurposed.
proposal.genericRationale: Incidents, observations and acknowledgement are reusable assurance concepts; no Doghouse filesystem or deployment fields enter capability.
proposal.problem: An isolated reference source must report a failure through accepted public events; an independent consumer must query and acknowledge its same-scope incident without knowing Doghouse internals.
providers: Native isolated Doghouse assurance domain planned after design freeze
Independent assurance implementation satisfying the same bounded public semantics (candidate, not implemented)
proposal.scopes: Existing application/session labels. Exact local data scope; no cross-scope correlation or implicit ancestry. Permissions are declarations, grants and current local mappings separately enforced.
proposal.security: Host supplies current caller and event provenance. Local current mappings separately restrict exact data scope and producer/target; imported provenance never becomes local authority. No executor, credentials or probes. Inproc binding is not hostile-code isolation.

evidence.reference: Current explicit Owner Phase5.2 execution grant authorizes existing local maintainer workflow. Genuine independent parent design review preserved; not human cryptographic signature or Owner Acceptance.

review.rationale: Independently inspected design at 03bf404d5f5dbefe0dc4222fac26b6a328435d46, exact archive SHA256 bf46ec8556e0bc02f1ce3a98b963a77134a912fecda4e9c924d7c74708555340, and F1 amendment 9120c30f4a663d99e7624639cf65bca59c3da2ef. Independently executed public event plus design tests5/5 PASS; reread ten-line F1 diff, verified DESIGN SHA256136edef29efff6cd17ce21e474ff4c26e772852da7b78aef47ce4420d51cf302 and reran design4/4 PASS. F1 closed: operation/ingestion1000ms, queue250ms, shutdown2000ms cooperative budgets with honest nonpreemption and postcommit uncertain-result semantics. Abstraction: minimal provider-neutral incident query/acknowledgement plus typed signal; distinct canonical exchange/store, not control. Security: broker provenance and separate current exact local target/actor authorization before replay; imported history never grants permission; bounded evidence and capacity; no operational invocation. Scopes: exact local data scopes, no cross-scope correlation, existing application/session labels are not grants. Compatibility: additive URI/event only, frozen SDK/Kernel/Foundation/Catalog unchanged, development snapshot not admission. Accept D5-D8 design only; historical semantic mapping NOT old-format compatibility. Actual implementation/conformance and maintainer transition plus admitted-snapshot validation mandatory before EXPERIMENTAL release. Independent final review still required. No technical completion, production/cutover/Owner Acceptance or phase5.3 authority.
